doc.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022

title: 'Snake in the Grass' name-that-tune
summary: Rowe plays a phrase on saxophone and Galper identifies his own tune 'Snake in the Grass'.

blocks.x: Okay. Well I have something — you want to play a little name that tune?
Okay. This is from that era, I’m going to see if I can pull this off and you tell me what it is [plays saxophone]
“Snake in the Grass.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
Oh you got it. We can move on.
It is your tune. Now just to make sure is it “Snake IN the Grass,” or is it “Snakin’ the Grass?”
It was supposed to be snake in the burbs.
